faqs.a:
Except as otherwise provided in this chapter, should any member cease to be a police
               officer in the employ of the city, for any reason except to become a retirant or by
               his death, he shall thereupon cease to be a member. In the event such person is reemployed
               by the city as a police officer, he shall again become a member and any credited service
               accrued by him, at the date he last ceased to be a member, may be restored to his
               credit; provided however, that said member shall refund and pay into the fund all
               contributions for such previous credited service as may have been refunded to him
               pursuant to the provisions of
section 86-43
, plus interest at a rate of six percent per annum of such amount. If the reemployed
               member does not elect to have his previous credited service restored by payment of
               reimbursed funds as provided in this section, then such previous service shall not
               be restored or credited to such member. In the event a member becomes a retirant or
               dies, he shall thereupon cease to be a member.
(Code 1960, § 19-5; Code 1981, § 26-15)
